text: こうして　ならんでると　はないち　もんめ　してる　みたい

structure.jp: こうして　ならんでると
structure.en: when we're lined up like this

structure.jp: はないち　もんめ　してる　みたい
structure.en: it's like we're playing Hana Ichi Monme

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'when this is so, that follows'. ならんでると = 'when we're lined up'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたい after a phrase means 'it's like' or 'it seems as if'. はないち もんめ してる みたい = 'it's like we're playing Hana Ichi Monme'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows a state that is in place; here it is shortened to てる as in casual speech. ならんでる = 'are lined up'.
